content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Frisco

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma plus five years. Document your hours and roles now. Granite PM Academy's advisors will review your background before enrollment to ensure you meet all prerequisites.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours Online
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp—instructor-led training delivered entirely online. Attend sessions on your schedule, interact with active certified practitioners, and cover the full PMBOK® Guide framework without traveling to a classroom. Completion of these hours is mandatory before applying to PMI.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the bootcamp, submit your formal application to PMI with proof of your education and project-management experience. Pay the associated examination fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy provides step-by-step guidance through the application portal so you avoid delays or rejections.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass Your Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy offers exam-preparation resources, practice questions, and strategy sessions to sharpen your readiness. You'll sit for the proctored PMP exam—a rigorous assessment of your knowledge and ability to manage complex projects across industries. Our support continues until you pass.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: Your PMP credential lasts three years and requires you to earn professional development units (PDUs) to renew. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU courses so you stay current with best practices and keep your certification active throughout your career in Frisco's competitive market.
